caption:
Nvidia stock jumped 31.48% on Monday to $165.05 after its board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, adding about $950 billion of market value, the biggest one-day dollar gain on record per 24/7 Wall St.
It is still about 5% below its November 11 close, and the board's investigation and the delayed quarterly report are still open.
